data.narrative: The student demonstrated outstanding mastery in Module 10 (Deployment). She successfully designed and deployed a decoupled multi-service containerized architecture with complete PostgreSQL and Redis service checks, robust database connection timeouts, and lifespan graceful shutdown hooks. Her work matches production-grade infrastructure standards.

dimension_scores.observation: Analyzed and selected multi-service deployment over single container bundling, recognizing that separating resources enforces the async decoupling goals of Module 7 and protects redirect latency.
dimension_scores.evidence: Option B: Multi-Service Deployment. Gain: API and worker are isolated, so heavy analytics jobs won't slow down redirects. Cost: More deployment complexity and risk of version drift. Why: It matches our Module 7 goal of keeping analytics separate...

dimension_scores.observation: Quickly isolated the uvicorn port mismatch bug, recognizing how hardcoding port 8000 inside Dockerfile CMD ignores Railway runtime environment variable mappings.
dimension_scores.evidence: Root cause: The app is listening on a hardcoded port (e.g., 8000) instead of the platform-provided PORT, so requests to 3000 never reach it. Fix: Read PORT from the environment...

dimension_scores.observation: Advocated for strict database liveness and readiness isolation to prevent catastrophic crash loops and cascade failures.
dimension_scores.evidence: Check dependencies (Postgres, Redis, etc.) to confirm the app is ready to serve traffic. /health endpoint... should not check databases, Redis, or external services.

dimension_scores.observation: Designed resilient db connection pools and uvicorn lifespan graceful shutdown hooks to drain in-flight requests and cleanly dispose connections on SIGTERM.
dimension_scores.evidence: Graceful shutdown: Lets in-flight requests finish and closes connections cleanly instead of abruptly terminating them.

dimension_scores.observation: Expressed complex multi-service container orchestration, connection timeouts, liveness vs readiness checks, and rollback migrations with extreme engineering precision.
dimension_scores.evidence: Check dependencies (Postgres, Redis, etc.) to confirm... Timeouts: Set reasonable DB, Redis, and HTTP timeouts to prevent requests from hanging forever...

strengths: Exceptional mastery of containerization and orchestration, advocating for strict environment configuration (build-time vs runtime).
Strong production thinking in isolating liveness and readiness probes to protect downstream service ingress routing.
data.recommendation: Bootcamp fully complete! Ready to ship production systems, manage scalable containerized services, and configure automated CI/CD pipelines in a professional environment.

public_evidence.student_action: Containerized the FastAPI application via multi-stage builds, injected connection pool timeouts, and set up complete GitHub Actions CI pipelines with isolated dependencies.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Multi-stage Dockerfile, connection-scoped timeouts in database.py, lifespan graceful shutdown context managers in main.py, and automated pytest CI workflow.
public_evidence.proof: Passed health and readiness positive checks locally, verified instant non-blocking 503 failures on Postgres and Redis downtime, and wrote complete lab notebook.
public_evidence.ability: Designing production-grade container builds, configuring liveness/readiness orchestration endpoints, implementing graceful lifecycle hooks, and establishing multi-service database timeouts.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Enforces total high-availability protection, rapid incident recovery, zero-downtime scaling, and secure continuous integration before any production deploy.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Student cleanly separated the responsibilities of /health liveness and /ready readiness probes.
Student correctly identified build-time config as static code/dependencies and runtime config as dynamic injected environment vars.

teaching_approaches.detail: Used pulse check versus accepting traffic analogy to explain health checks to the student.
